limits: The aggregate NREP32 report exposes only one event group. The 32 explicit-seed runs give selected separate observations, not the aggregate's hidden replication timelines.
Each log creates a root mission ID 0, followed by exactly three child starts with IDs 1-3; root creation is not an extra mission start.
The 32 selected seed event logs are byte-identical, but this finite matrix does not establish behavior for all seeds or other zero-period combinations.
The manual's IPER=0 rule is consistent with this fixed three-mission, three-aircraft result; other counts, distributions, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain untested.
